title: Key Account Manager
summary: A key account manager owns a company's biggest customers, such as national retail chains, quick commerce apps or large business buyers, and grows sales and profit from each one. The role sits in the sales team, works with supply chain, marketing and finance, and usually reports to a national or regional sales head.
dailyDuties: Review weekly sales, fill rate and stock for each account
Negotiate margins, listings and promotions with buyers
Update joint business plans and the monthly forecast
Track trade spend and promotion ROI against budget
Resolve billing, claims and short-supply issues with internal teams
Run business reviews with buyers and category managers

skills.expectation: Own a set of large accounts and run joint business plans with each
Negotiate margins, trade terms, listings and annual contracts
Forecast monthly volume by account and track it against target
Manage trade spend and account profitability and report promotion ROI
Resolve billing and claims issues and keep account receivables on time
Build account trackers, sales reports and promotion analysis in Excel
Work with supply chain, marketing and finance to serve the account
Run periodic business reviews with buyers and category managers
Know modern trade chains and quick commerce platforms and their store-level execution
Coordinate with distributors or stockists who service the accounts
Keep account plans and opportunities in a CRM
Track fill rates and account sales in dashboards
Grow share of wallet and renew contracts in existing accounts
